convert_idefics2_hub_to_hf: convert an Idefics2 model from the original text-only format to the HuggingFace multimodal format
merge_weights: merge separate model weights into combined tensors for the converted Idefics2 model
convert_state_dict_to_hf: convert a state dictionary key naming scheme to the HuggingFace Idefics2 format
get_config: retrieve and reconstruct an Idefics2Config from the original model checkpoint configuration
run_convert_idefics2_cli: run the Idefics2 weight conversion CLI with original model id, output path, and optional hub push
